trigger.description: What set the feeling off? Name the moment, event or perception the text presents as starting the response it dwells on most. Not the topic of the text and not its subject; if the text states a feeling without an initiating event, null.
trigger.x_constraints: 1-5 words, single string. Referent rule: name ONE referent that the text itself mentions, using the text's own noun phrase where it has one; if several candidates qualify, choose the one the text returns to most; use the most specific noun phrase the text itself uses; do not substitute a category the text does not use and do not add detail the text does not give. Null when no passage supports an answer; never null when one does. Arm B definition adopted by R12 (2026-10-18); v0.8.3 spark read: 'What triggered or initiated the emotional response'.

self_position.description: The subject's own expressed lens on themselves within the story: the position they say they occupy (e.g. "the one who holds it together", "the person who finally said no"). STATED-ONLY: recorded only when the subject says it or paraphrases it unmistakably; never assigned from the plot, the emotion or an archetype catalogue.
self_position.x_constraints: Short phrase in the subject's own terms; NULL when not stated. Replaces narrative_archetype (the Mark & Pearson 12 are not used). Optional codings: McAdams imago (open label), agency / communion, Hermans I-position; all relation=related.
